messages.content: Find an Italian restaurant near me in New York that provides vegetarian food options and a Japanese sushi restaurant in Los Angeles that offers delivery service.

function.name: restaurant_finder
function.description: Search for restaurants based on location, cuisine type and other preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: City and state, e.g. New York, NY.

preferences.description: Extra features in the restaurant. default is ['Delivery'].

The cuisine is "Italian". The second location is "Los Angeles, CA" or "Los Angeles". The cuisine is "Japanese". The user didn't specify city and state for the second, but we can assume "Los Angeles, CA". The function expects location string. So we can call the function twice.
